architect.cite: The confirmation step replaces the separate independent re-run
architect.reply_head:
Yes

The design is minimal. It is a single Experimental entry, and step 6 stays in place, so no other rule is touched. It is enforceable without false positives, because the record already shows the primary window, each amendment and each confirmation, and the runner can check that mechanically. The re-run is still available on request, and it is mandatory for agreement changes with nothing to confirm. That keeps a backstop where the confirmation step has nothing to check.

Notes:
- The "any voter asks" trigger should be recorded in the Decider record, so it can be audited.
- The counter-metric needs a named owner to review single-window erro
